claims: The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match took place on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match took place at Wembley Stadium in London.
Kick-off of the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match was at 3 p.m. BST.
The stream of the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match started at 2:10 p.m. BST on YouTube.
The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match featured Sidemen FC against the YouTube Allstars.
The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match was to raise funds for charity.
Beneficiaries of the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match included Bright Side and M7 Education.
The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match was streamed live on the official Sidemen YouTube channel.
